name: workspace
services:
  display-server:
    build:
      context: /workspace
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: display-server
    environment:
      ADMIN_EMAIL: admin@example.com
      API_BASE_URL: https://your_tenant-api.smart-city-booking.de/api
      APP_PASSWORD: your_password
      APP_USERNAME: your_username
      BASE_PATH: /display-server
      CLIENT_REFRESH_SECONDS: "60"
      FETCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS: "300"
      FQDN: booking-service.example.com
      TENANT: your_tenant
    image: display-server:latest
    networks:
      shared-net: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 8001
        published: "8001"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: always
networks:
  shared-net:
    name: shared-net
    external: true
